confidence_legend.size: SIZES ARE PLANNING ESTIMATES from known 2024-2025 figures; every entry must be byte-verified against its manifest at acquisition (Team E law). Do not treat estimates as measured storage.

entries.name: Wikipedia English — complete, no-images ZIM
entries.license_note: Attribution + share-alike. Permits redistribution offline. Compliant.
entries.usefulness: Core general reference. The single highest-value offline knowledge object that exists.
entries.risks: ZIM updates quarterly; re-acquire on schedule to stay current.
entries.verify_at_acquisition: exact ZIM size + internal md5/checksum from download.kiwix.org

entries.name: Wiktionary English — complete ZIM
entries.usefulness: Dictionary + etymology + translations. Answers 'what does X mean' offline.

entries.name: Project Gutenberg — curated top 10,000 books
entries.license: Public domain (US), per-book license itemized in catalog
entries.license_note: US public domain. Redistribute freely. Do not use the Gutenberg brand to sell.
entries.usefulness: World literature, history, reference classics. Highest-value literary offline library per GB.
entries.acquisition: Curated bookshelf lists (agriculture, business, science, history) via rsync-able catalog
entries.risks: Individual items must be checked (a small minority are restricted-distribution under trademark rules).
entries.verify_at_acquisition: per-book license field from PG catalog

entries.name: OpenStax complete textbook catalog
entries.license: CC BY 4.0 (majority; a few CC BY-NC-SA)
entries.usefulness: University-grade math, physics, chemistry, biology, economics, accounting, business, statistics textbooks. Directly serves Dad's education priority list.
entries.risks: Small catalog (~30-60 titles) but exceptional quality.

entries.name: Standard Ebooks — full catalog
entries.license_note: CC0 — zero restriction. Best-in-class formatting of classic literature.
entries.usefulness: Carefully proofed, formatted public-domain literature and nonfiction.

entries.name: Wikibooks + Wikivoyage + Wikisource (English ZIMs)
entries.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (content); Wikisource texts are mostly public domain

entries.name: MedlinePlus — consumer health encyclopedia
entries.license: US federal government work — public domain
entries.license_note: Freely reusable. Authoritative public-health education for the health priority.
entries.usefulness: Plain-language medical reference: diseases, drugs, wellness. High-stakes info carries publication dates and source attribution as Dad requires.
entries.acquisition: NLM bulk downloads / Kiwix ZIM where available
entries.risks: Medical info requires dated snapshots — record retrieval date per document.
entries.verify_at_acquisition: NLM terms page at acquisition time

entries.name: devdocs.io full offline set + MDN Web Docs
entries.license: MIT/open (devdocs app); MDN content CC BY-SA / Apache 2.0
entries.usefulness: Complete programming/API documentation offline. Serves HARZ's own build work and Dad's technical-education priority.
entries.acquisition: devdocs offline packs; MDN periodic content dumps

entries.name: OpenStreetMap Nigeria + West Africa extracts + GeoNames gazetteer
entries.usefulness: Offline maps, coordinates, administrative boundaries, settlement data. Foundational for a Nigerian offline node.
entries.acquisition: Geofabrik .osm.pbf extracts; GeoNames allCountries dump (filter to region)
entries.risks: ODbL share-alike applies to derived databases.

entries.name: FSI language courses (incl. Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo-related materials)
entries.provider: US Foreign Service Institute (via fsi-languages.yojik.eu mirrors)
entries.language: English instruction; target languages incl. Hausa
entries.usefulness: Complete structured audio+text courses. Directly serves the African-languages priority.
entries.acquisition: Mirror archives (verify mirror integrity vs. known copies)
entries.risks: Mirror sites vary in reliability; verify file integrity.

entries.name: Kolibri offline learning platform + curated channels (PhET simulations, African Storybook, TESSA teacher training)
entries.license: Platform MIT; channel content licenses vary (PhET: CC BY; African Storybook: CC BY; TESSA: CC BY-SA)
entries.usefulness: Structured curricula (math, science, reading) designed for exactly HARZ's offline use case; African Storybook includes Hausa early readers.
entries.risks: License varies per channel — check each channel's stated license before inclusion.

entries.name: Khan Academy — exercises + text (video-free) via Kolibri
entries.license_note: NON-COMMERCIAL. Lawful for private/educational offline use, but NC terms must be flagged: HARZ may use internally, must check before any redistribution.
entries.usefulness: The strongest structured math curriculum in existence. Video-full version balloons to 40GB+; exercises+text keep it tiny.
entries.risks: NC license flag; video content excluded to protect storage.

entries.name: FAO + CGIAR agriculture and livestock documents (curated selection)
entries.license: FAO: mostly CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; CGIAR: largely CC BY 4.0
entries.usefulness: Crops, soil, livestock, post-harvest practice from the authoritative global sources. Coordinates with Team D's agriculture priority.
entries.acquisition: Per-document PDF with license + date recorded
entries.recommended_for_stage: Stage 2 Expand (agriculture pillar, handoff to Team D lead for final selection)
entries.risks: FAO IGO licenses carry NC terms — flag; record publication dates.

entries.name: Hausa Wikipedia + Nigerian-language Wikimedia projects (ZIMs)
entries.usefulness: Small but symbolic: offline knowledge in Nigerian languages.
entries.recommended_for_stage: Stage 2 Expand (languages pillar, supports Team D)
entries.risks: Coverage is thin — expectation honesty: useful, not comprehensive.

entries.name: Project Gutenberg — COMPLETE collection (~75,000+ books)
entries.usefulness: Full archive scale. Only after Tier 1-2 is ingested and verified.
entries.acquisition: Official torrent / mirror rsync, batched per Team E
entries.risks: Storage-heavy; duplicates Tier-1 subset — dedupe law applies.

entries.name: Stack Exchange data dumps (Stack Overflow + selected sites)
entries.usefulness: The practical-questions web archive: programming, electronics, math, cooking, law-adjacent. Real-world problem-solving knowledge.
entries.risks: Size: select sites, not the whole network. Requires import/transformation per Team E.

entries.name: LibreTexts + DOAB open-access books (selective)
entries.provider: LibreTexts / Directory of Open Access Books
entries.license: LibreTexts: mostly CC BY-NC-SA; DOAB: varies per book (CC BY preferred filter)
entries.usefulness: Deep STEM and academic coverage beyond OpenStax.
entries.acquisition: Per-book with license recorded; filter DOAB to CC BY only
entries.risks: NC flags on LibreTexts; DOAB requires per-book license filtering.

entries.name: arXiv — selective field mirror (math, CS, physics)
entries.license: Metadata CC0; papers vary (arXiv non-exclusive license to distribute)
entries.usefulness: Research-grade knowledge. Niche for HARZ's current audience — included for completeness.
entries.acquisition: Bulk data access via requester-pays S3 (free request tier) or Kaggle/other mirrors
entries.risks: License varies per paper; large; S3 transfer costs are $0 only within free tier rules — verify.

entries.name: Web-archive lane: ZIM-packaged site archives (extends the existing corpus-hunting queue)
entries.provider: Kiwix Zimit / existing HARZ offline-browser queue
entries.license: PER-SITE: only sites whose terms permit archiving/redistribution
entries.usefulness: The 'expandable web archive' half of ruling C. Reuses the standing 7-agent queue infrastructure already built (65 domains day-1, 200-cap law).
entries.acquisition: Site-by-site via the existing queue; legal review per domain before packaging
entries.risks: Licensing must be checked per site — no uncontrolled bulk ingestion (Dad's explicit law). This catalog does NOT authorize bulk web harvesting.
entries.verify_at_acquisition: per-site robots/terms review recorded in manifest

team_c_laws_for_this_catalog: RECOMMEND BEFORE DOWNLOAD: this catalog authorizes nothing by itself; acquisition begins only after Dad approves entries and Team A's inventory + Team E's storage measurements are in.
SIZES ARE ESTIMATES: every acquisition batch must byte-verify against its manifest (Team E law).
NC-FLAGGED SOURCES (Khan Academy, FAO, LibreTexts) are lawful for internal/educational offline use; redistribution requires a separate review.
LICENSES RE-VERIFY AT ACQUISITION: sources change terms; the license recorded at download time is the one that binds.
AUTHORITATIVE FIRST: quality rank beats byte count. 15GB of Tier-1 sources outperforms 100GB of indiscriminate bulk.

Two lawful paths: (1) curated first batch within 2.2GB (below), or (2) Dad's explicit cap/storage ruling — device-side storage (laptop disk) can host the 60GB reference library without touching the D1 cap. NO PREMATURE CAP RAISE per standing ruling; C proposes, Dad decides.
